name: Composition Guide
description: Applies photographic composition principles to a described subject including rule of thirds grid placement, leading lines direction, foreground/background layering, frame-within-frame opportunities, and negative space allocation. Produces specific framing instructions applicable to any camera. Use when the user asks about photo composition, framing a shot, or arranging visual elements in a photograph. Do NOT use for exposure or camera settings (use exposure-triangle), lighting setup (use lighting-setup), or post-processing workflow (use photo-editing-workflow).
